title: Guide d'information et de sensibilisation des nouveaux bacheliers 2026-2027
publisher: Ministère de l'Enseignement Supérieur et de la Recherche Scientifique
why_not: The Plateforme des bacheliers (apresmonbac.bj) is the higher-education ministry's platform for ranking and placing new baccalaureate holders in public universities, in use since 2020; higher education is outside the study and it is single-function.
